subject: Audit-ready custodial manifest: personnel training & background artifacts
messages:
From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@helio.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Audit artifacts: sample set for personnel & training verification

Hi Mateo,

Helio's SOC2 engagement team is preparing the personnel controls sampling. For scope we need:
- A manifest of all new hires between 2025-08-01 and 2026-07-31 with hire date, role, verification status (background complete / pending), and training completion date.
- Two redacted BG check samples (one contractor, one employee).
- Onboarding/offboarding runbook that auditors can reference (redact PII where appropriate).

Could you confirm whether you can provide a time-stamped package and a secure link by EOD Wednesday (2026-08-19)? If you have an internal index file already, that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Sara Jenkins
Senior Compliance Manager, Helio Financial Services

--
Sara Jenkins
Helio Financial Services | audit-team@helio.com

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@helio.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit artifacts: sample set for personnel & training verification

Sara — thanks for the clear ask. We can supply everything on your list. Quick notes and proposed delivery plan: 

1) Manifest: we have a personnel-training-index.csv exported from HRIS that contains hire date, title bucket, BG status (redacted), training completion date and verifier initials. I will sanitize PII and include verifier audit timestamps.

2) BG samples: we will attach two redacted PDFs (contractor and employee) with personal identifiers removed except initials and verification date as required by the auditor.

3) Runbook: our onboarding/offboarding runbook (onboard-offboard-runbook_v2.pdf) includes access provisioning, account activation checklist, and deprovisioning steps. We'll produce a version with redactions/comments turned on to highlight auditor-relevant sections.

Action owners: 
- Karthik: produce redacted BG sample and confirm redaction method (which fields removed).
- Laura: export the manifest and remove PII columns; add verifier timestamps.
- Mateo (me): assemble the package, upload to a secure Drive folder, and provide a time-stamped manifest link + MD5 of archive.

Target: deliver package and link by Wed 2026-08-19 16:00 PT. If that works I'll start the exports now.

Thanks,
Mateo
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 14:27:00 -07:00

On Tue, Aug 17, 2026 at 10:03 AM Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Karthik: produce redacted BG sample and confirm redaction method (which fields removed).

I'll take the BG redaction. Plan:
- Pull two clearance reports (one full-time, one 1099 contractor) from BackgroundVendor portal.
- Remove SSN, DOB, address. Keep initials, verification result, adjudication date, and vendor reference ID.
- Watermark with "redacted for external audit" and add a single-line attest footer: "Redwood redaction performed 2026-08-18 by K. Iyer".

I'll drop the PDFs into the shared Drive 'Helio-Audit' folder and post the links here once complete. Estimated drop: 2026-08-18 18:30 PT.

-k

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@helio.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2026 16:03:00 -07:00

Sara — delivering the requested package. Contents attached and available via secure link below.

Package summary:
- personnel-training-index.csv (sanitized) — columns: hire_date, role_bucket, bg_status, training_completed_at, verifier_initials, hr_export_id.
- bg-check-sample-redacted.pdf (employee)

Secure link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Helio-Audit/2026-personnel-manifest (expiring link, access audited)
DocuSign acknowledgement: DocuSign: 0x7a9f-audit-evidence-ack

Notes: 
- Redaction summary included in personnel-training-index.csv (redaction_method column = hashed_personal_id, removed_fields = [SSN, DOB, address]).
- We retained minimal verifier metadata to support timeline verification.

Attachment stubs: [personnel-training-index.csv (CSV), bg-check-sample-redacted.pdf (PDF), bg-check-sample-redacted-contractor.pdf (PDF), onboard-offboard-runbook_v2.pdf (PDF)]
